senses.gloss:
1 A triad, triplet.
--2 The
three sacred fires taken
collectively; Ms. 2. 231; R. 13. 37.
--3 A
particular throw at dice, a cast of
three or trey; त्रेताहृतसर्वस्वः
Mk. 2. 8.
--4 The second of the four Yugas
of the Hindus; see युग.

त्रेधा ind. Trebly, in three ways
or parts; तदेकं सत्त्रेधाख्यायते Śat.
Br.; (नमः) तुभ्यं त्रेधा स्थितात्मने
R. 10. 16.
